notes: The ASV recasts the Greek clause: θάμβος takes amazed, περιέσχεν the copula, αὐτόν the English subject; joining θάμβος περιέσχεν as one was amazed unit remains defensible and is named in the unit note.
πάντας τοὺς σὺν αὐτῷ: the article keeps only the relativizer because πάντας already carries all, and the copula rides with σύν under rule 53.
